summary: Rewrite the sum over congruent near pairs as a sum over tuples (codimension i, label t, class c, subspace T = commonLink, terms q, p); for codimension m bound the p-sum and the q-sum by tsum_invPowWeight_le_of_codim_le (codimensions ≤ m+ϱ+1 and m), the divisibility hypotheses coming from lattice inclusions given by the links, and the sum over classes and subspaces by sum_latticeDisc_inv_le; against countWeight(m) this gives 2^{−m}τ², summing to 2τ².

steps.claim: Use the size facts; write the sum through the fibres of the map from tuples (i, t, c, T, q, p) — q a labelled term, T a subspace with dim T + i = k, p a labelled term congruent to q with commonLink = T — to (c, c', γ, γ'); it suffices to bound each pairWeight by its fibre sum and the total over tuples.

apply S.of_size_bounds; intros; apply ((tsum_fiberwise (fun (⟨i, t, c, T, q, p⟩ : Σ i t c, Σ (T :
    {T : Submodule E (𝔰.κ → E) // finrank E T + i = 𝔰.k}) (q : ofPred (S.IsLabelledTerm j c t)),
    {p | S.IsLabelledTerm j c t p ∧ S.CongruentTerms c p.1 q.1.2 p.2 ∧ commonLink q.1.2 p.2 = T}) ↦
    S.termWeight j i c q p T) fun ⟨_, _, c, _, q, p⟩ ↦ (c, p.1.1, q.1.2, p.1.2)).trans_le ?_).trans'
